facts: A10 UTS deterministic/frontend checks passed and cargo.lock.offline-recheck exposed the host offline serde 1.0.228 cache line against the former direct serde 1.0.229 pin; A11 retains the agreed serde 1.0.228 direct compatibility pin.

The first A11 UTS (20260915T054436Z) passed deterministic/frontend gates, then online cargo generate-lockfile selected exact serde_json 1.0.151 while the immediate offline recheck exposed only the host-cached serde_json 1.0.149 line for Tauri.

The A11 verifier previously ran locked cargo fetch only after cargo.lock.offline-recheck; A11 now performs online lock generation plus locked network fetch, deletes that online lock, regenerates Cargo.lock offline, requires byte-equivalence, then continues with locked offline fetch/test/build.
Schema v5 stores import receipts, principal identifiers, capability metadata and opaque portable JSON, but no device private key or board key bytes.

Portable bundle v1 is validated as board-scoped application state, requires an empty/fresh A11 migration destination, preserves stable logical UUIDs plus restoreHints/unknown metadata, and has a deterministic parse-export-parse compatibility test including exact non-null card archivedAt preservation.
Device-link/2 provisioning binds the grant scope/epoch/subject to a fresh native replica and vault-only board/device secret material.

Web-node-link v1 destination provisioning requires an empty native profile, binds capability subjects to the fresh native principal public key, and records omissions for deployment/session/device state, shared workspaces and node-local hides.
Import application uses one SQLite IMMEDIATE transaction and does not insert pending_local_changes.
The native runtime wires ImportService without adding a Tauri import/file/keyring command; the main WebView permission list stays empty.
inferences: A network-only cargo generate-lockfile is index/lock preparation, not sufficient fresh-host crate-cache preparation; pinning direct dependencies to arbitrary historical cache contents would make acceptance host-history dependent.
Treating imported state as replica seed rather than a local mutation avoids echoing restored content through the A10 outbox path.

Vault-before-DB ordering plus collision rejection is the safer cross-resource failure direction because a crash can leave only unreachable secret material rather than an active board without its required key.
Preserving unknown portable sections and entity fields as validated JSON avoids silent data loss before A12 promotes more fields to first-class native entities.

For A11 migration, preserving stable logical UUIDs in a fresh profile is safer than interpreting restoreHints.create_copy as an ID-remap instruction because coexistence must not fork logical board identity; generic copy/restore UI semantics remain out of scope.
proposals: A12 should consume the preserved label/comment/activity/appearance sections as first-class native parity data without changing A11 secret or import boundaries.
A16 recovery/doctor may detect and clean unreachable orphan vault material created by a process crash in the Secret Service-to-SQLite commit window.
